description: This file defines a PHP class HTMLPurifier_Token_Empty that extends HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag, representing a specific type of token in the HTMLPurifier library used for processing HTML tokens, specifically an 'empty' token.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Empty
classes.description: A class representing an 'empty' token in the HTMLPurifier HTML tokenization process, extends HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag and overrides toNode() to mark the node as empty.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Converts the token to a node object and marks it as empty by setting the 'empty' property to true.
